changelog.item: The custom filter for releases can now filter out irrelevant downloaded files at the same time.
Added sorting by the time a repository is starred.

Adjusted repository search: currently, entering a keyword triggers real-time repository name matching, while clicking AI Search will retrieve AI-analyzed content, tags, etc., speeding up search. Natural language search is temporarily disabled due to unsatisfactory results.
Add a check for updates feature
Persistent sorting for repository list
Added AI detection concurrency configuration
Unified repository card tag styles
Improved AI analysis failure indicators and added a retry button for failed items
fix: Fixed the issue where the analysis progress becomes 0 due to switching headers during AI analysis
Add drag and no-drag regions for desktop app
switch to infinite scroll with consistent card widths
fix: Sidebar now scrolls vertically when its content exceeds the screen height, preventing hidden or inaccessible items and improving navigation on smaller screens or long lists.
fix: Fixed webdav backup recovery issue.
feat: Supports multiple AI API formats and fixes connectivity testing.
feat: Added an optional Express + SQLite backend server, supporting cross-device automatic synchronization.
Added optional OpenAI Responses API support while preserving existing OpenAI Chat Completions compatibility.
Fixed repository update time display and sorting by prioritizing pushed_at, with fallback to updated_at.
Fixed white-screen crash when opening empty categories by correcting React Hook call order.
Fixed the desktop white-screen startup issue after IndexedDB migration by normalizing persisted state before first render.
Ensured seamless data migration from legacy localStorage to IndexedDB without requiring users to reset local data.
Kept rollback compatibility so users can return to older versions without losing existing data.
Added category lock support in repository edit panel to prevent sync from overwriting manual category choices.
Manual category changes now auto-enable lock by default, and users can still manually unlock later.
Improved edit modal defaults by preferring AI summary as editable custom description content.
Added repository unstar support and improved delete flow stability by handling 204 No Content responses and cleaning related release/subscription state.
Fixed desktop first-login token paste issue (Ctrl/Cmd + V) in v0.2.0-v0.2.2 builds.
Restored global search shortcuts and desktop Edit menu roles (cut/copy/paste/select all) for consistent keyboard behavior.
Improved sync stability, backend auth handling, and mobile layout refinements. (Thanks @HuberttFox for the contribution.)
Added a release list unsubscribe action with confirmation and immediate sync.
Fixed macOS App/Window menu missing in desktop build, restoring Command+Q (quit) and Command+W (close window) shortcuts.
Fixed SyntaxError in generated main.js caused by improper string escaping in the build workflow.
Kept already loaded repository cards visible during sync, so refreshes no longer interrupt reading flow.
Preserved scroll position after repository sync to avoid sudden jumps in long lists.
Persisted repository view context, including the selected category and current view, across refresh and reload.
Updated the app and login icon assets to use the project icon consistently.
Improved nginx proxy resilience for containerized deployments by using a more reliable backend upstream setup. Thanks to external contributor @HuberttFox for PR #60.
Added optional reasoning effort support for GPT-5 compatible OpenAI APIs.
Kept backward compatibility by leaving reasoning disabled unless users explicitly enable it.
Persisted the reasoning setting across frontend config state, backend config APIs, import/export, and database migration.
Improved compatibility for OpenAI Responses and reasoning-enabled requests with longer request and connection test timeouts.
Normalized legacy unsupported reasoning value minimal to low to prevent request failures with GPT-5 compatible models.
Added observable decryption failure handling for stored AI API keys, WebDAV passwords, and GitHub tokens.
Kept settings APIs responsive even when one stored secret cannot be decrypted, instead of failing the entire response.
Returned per-secret status metadata so the frontend can distinguish normal, empty, and decrypt-failed states.
Added clear Settings warnings telling users to re-enter and save configurations whose stored secrets can no longer be decrypted.
Improved debugging by logging decryption failures with config context on the backend.
Improved AI summary parsing by stripping fenced JSON code blocks before extraction.
Replaced fragile greedy JSON matching with balanced-brace parsing to better handle wrapped responses.
Increased the AI analysis token budget to reduce failures caused by truncated structured output.
Added hide/show for built-in categories - default categories can be hidden from sidebar and restored from Settings.
Added delete support for custom categories without affecting repository starred status.
Added drag-and-drop category assignment - drag repository cards onto sidebar categories to quickly assign.
Added category lock - manually assigned categories won't be changed by subsequent AI analysis or sync.
Added AI category matching - AI analysis now considers custom categories and assigns repositories accordingly.
Fixed Gemini connection test failures by increasing maxTokens threshold. Thanks to @Minttc for the contribution!
Fixed DeepSeek Reasoner compatibility by removing unsupported API parameters.
Fixed sidebar layout - category count badges are now properly aligned without layout shifts on hover.
Fixed backend persistence - category lock state is now properly synced to the database.
Fixed category rename - renaming a custom category now updates all assigned repositories.
Tabbed Settings Interface: Settings are now organized into dedicated panels (General, AI, WebDAV, Backup, Backend, Category, Data Management) with mobile-friendly tab navigation.
Repository Multi-Select and Bulk Actions: Select multiple repositories at once with a bulk actions toolbar, bulk categorization modal, and pipelined AI-summary bulk processing.
README Modal: View repository READMEs with an improved Markdown renderer featuring safer link and image handling.
Back-to-Top Button: Quick navigation for long lists.
WebDAV Backup/Restore: Backup your data to WebDAV and restore when needed.
Backend Sync Controls: Sync your data across devices with backend integration.
AI Config Management: Configure and manage AI service settings.
Preset Asset Filters: Quick filter presets for release assets.
Category Management and Ordering: Organize categories with drag-and-drop reordering.
Settings Refactor: Settings split into focused subpanels for better organization.
New UI utilities and animations (scrollbars, touch helpers, slide/shake/bounce effects).
README decoding now preserves UTF-8 encoding.
More robust Markdown and link handling.
Special thanks to @SummerRay160 for their tremendous contributions to this release!
AI Configuration Panel: Added connection testing for AI services to validate availability before use.
Prompt Management: Enhanced prompt editing and display logic with better management experience.
Default Category Override: Modify name, icon, and keywords for default categories with reset functionality.
Category Keywords: Added keyword support for categories with keyword input during creation/editing.
Trending View: New navigation entry with four channels - Most Stars, Most Forks, Top Developers, and Trending.
Batch AI Analysis: Reuse AIAnalysisOptimizer for subscription content with pause/resume/stop controls.
Backend Proxy: New Search API proxy routes for backend mode supporting GitHub Search.
Trending Filters: Time-range (daily/weekly/monthly) and language input for trending discovery.
Improved responsive layout for better mobile and desktop adaptation.
Full Chinese and English localization for all trending channels.
Fixed merge conflicts and tag rendering issues in subscription feature.
Special thanks to @SummerRay160 (PR #84, #85) and @chan-yuu (PR #86) for their contributions!
Discovery View Refactor: Replaced subscription view with a new Discovery view featuring channel-based browsing, multi-filter sorting, search, pagination, and a "Load more" button. (PR #90)
Enhanced Markdown renderer with syntax highlighting, copyable code blocks, image zoom/modal, in-modal TOC, heading navigation, and adjustable font size. (PR #90)
Added in-page AI analysis controls for repository cards with star/unstar support and safer clipboard helpers. (PR #90)
Improved responsive layout with Inter font family, refined breakpoints, and lucide-react icons throughout. (PR #90)
Switched Trending data source from GitHub Search API to GitHubTrendingRSS for more reliable results, with daily/weekly/monthly time-range filter. (PR #96)
Added RSS description parsing with HTML entity decoding, and supplemented RSS data with GitHub API for missing repository fields. (PR #96)
Fixed macOS desktop white-screen crash by removing Inter/CDN stylesheet loading and hardening discovery state rehydration. (PR #95)
Removed auto-loading pagination from Discovery view and fixed null/empty description handling in RepositoryEditModal. (PR #97)
Special thanks to @SummerRay160 for their outstanding contributions to this release (PR #90, #97)!
Added OpenAI-compatible API option for AI analysis.
Improved README modal with better TOC navigation, smooth heading scrolling, progress bar, and back-to-top button.
Enhanced Markdown rendering with better accessibility, image zoom/pan, and refined code block styling.
Added per-channel load more discovery state and controls.
Added plain-text Markdown stripping utility and introduced Vitest test suites.
Applied a centralized design token system across all components for consistent light/dark mode surfaces, text tiers, status colors, and brand accents (blue to violet).
App now defaults to dark theme on startup with smooth color transitions when switching themes.
Unified selected states for repository filters and highlighted subscribed release state on repository cards.
Added clearer hover feedback for repository cards and replaced unstar icons with a clearer action icon.
Aligned discovery sidebar/layout, improved discovery channel icon contrast, and normalized data management icons.
Fixed discovery filter trigger and last refreshed visibility/styling.
Special thanks to @SummerRay160 for their outstanding contributions to this release!

Added visible purple focus ring to all form inputs in AI Configuration, WebDAV, Backend, and Category Management panels. Previously, inputs showed no visual feedback when focused — especially after dismissing an alert dialog — making fields appear unresponsive. (PR #110)

Fixed Tailwind class typo: bg-light-surfaceborder-black/[0.06] (missing space) was processed as an invalid class name, breaking background and border styles on multiple form controls. Corrected to bg-light-surface border-black/[0.06]. (PR #110)
Removed hardcoded version string from UpdateService.getCurrentVersion() and replaced it with an import from package.json, so the version number stays in sync automatically. (PR #111)
Improved sidebar scroll behavior and fixed theme persistence across sessions. (PR #105)
Special thanks to @SummerRay160 for contributing to this release!

Update Dialog Portal Fix: Fixed the update dialog backdrop mask being trapped inside the overflow container. The dialog now renders via React Portal at the document body level with proper z-index stacking. Added click-on-mask-to-dismiss behavior for better UX. (PR #112)
Banner Layout Improvements: Fixed banner button wrapping on narrow viewports. Removed invalid Tailwind classes and improved responsive layout with proper flex behavior. (PR #112)
Electron Focus Hijacking Fix: Replaced native alert()/confirm() dialogs with custom React components (Toast and ConfirmDialog), resolving focus trapping issues in Electron. (PR #117)

Category Lock Toggle Visibility: Improved the category lock toggle color differentiation in dark mode. Unlocked state now uses gray-600, locked state uses amber. Both states are clearly distinguishable. (PR #118)
AI Connection Test Enhancements: AI connection test now returns detailed, user-facing results including status and guidance messages. (PR #114)

AI Configuration Error Handling: AI analysis now properly blocks execution when API keys are empty or cannot be decrypted. Bulk AI config import now skips entries without usable keys and logs reasons. (PR #114)
Unified Error Messages and UI Polish: Consolidated AI configuration error messages and improved markdown image/GitHub link dark-mode styling. (PR #114)
Special thanks to @SummerRay160 for their outstanding contributions to this release!

Fix: Gemini channel API endpoint URL display issue — selecting Gemini type now auto-fills the official default endpoint and constructs the correct v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent path automatically. (PR #123)

Feat: UI refactor with light mode improvements — enhanced focus rings, textarea scrolling/resize behavior, mobile typography, custom scrollbars, and improved tooltip readability in light mode. Added configurable font sizes for rendered content. (PR #128, contribution by @SummerRay160)

Fix: Complete Release sync mechanism — incremental sync for existing repos, paginated fetching of up to 30 releases per repo, rate limit handling with automatic wait, pre-release toggle with persisted preference, and failure count summary after refresh. (PR #129)

Feat: Bilingual README viewer with translate/revert controls — three display modes (original/translated/bilingual), per-heading translation support, auto-translate option, retry/abort flows, and robust handling for large documents. (PR #130, contribution by @SummerRay160)
Special thanks to @SummerRay160 for their outstanding contributions to this release!
New Forks View: Added a "Forks" tab in the top navigation bar between Releases and Trending for browsing and managing forked repositories. (PR #132)
Fork list sorted by upstream repository last update time (descending), with refresh button that checks for upstream updates and shows unread badge.
Per-fork cards showing language badge, source/parent info, unread pulse indicator, relative update times, and external repo link.
"Sync Upstream" button calls GitHub merge upstream API to sync Fork with upstream, with progress and localized success/error toasts.
Search, pagination, refresh with last-refresh time, and persisted view/search/preferences.
feat: Added data-translate attribute support to skip specific elements during AI translation. (PR #134, contribution by @SummerRay160)
fix: Fixed releases sync INSERT statement missing one placeholder, causing SqliteError on every release sync. (PR #140, contribution by @iamvicliu)
fix: Fixed better-sqlite3 RangeError when saving AI/WebDAV config objects — complex values are now properly JSON-serialized. (PR #140, contribution by @iamvicliu)

fix: Gemini thinking model support — raised maxTokens to 2048 for connection tests, extended timeout to 30s, and filtered out thinking trace parts from responses. (PR #140, contribution by @iamvicliu)
fix: Prevented starred repos from disappearing when page is refreshed within 2 seconds of sync by pushing data to backend immediately after fetching. (PR #142, contribution by @iamvicliu)
fix: Guard against empty backend response silently wiping locally-cached repos — local data is now preserved when backend returns empty. (PR #142, contribution by @iamvicliu)
fix: Disabled thinking chain for Xiaomi MiMo models to prevent reasoning content from leaking into analysis results. Fixes #127. (PR #143)

fix: Added automatic retry with exponential backoff for sync network errors (ERR_CONNECTION_RESET), increased frontend sync timeout from 30s to 120s, bumped nginx proxy timeouts to 300s with proxy_buffering off. Fixes #133. (PR #144)
feat: Show AI analysis failure reason on hover — tooltip icon displays specific error messages when analysis fails. (PR #154)
fix: AI search not triggering and no feedback when search returns empty results. (PR #146, contribution by @hych0317)
fix: Preserve local repository metadata during backend sync — AI analysis info no longer gets overwritten. (PR #147, contribution by @hych0317)
fix: Add subscribed_to_releases to local fields list and fix hash loop write issue. (PR #148)
fix: Disable macOS code signing to prevent "app is damaged" Gatekeeper error. (PR #152)
fix: Empty CSC_LINK causes macOS CI build failure with "not a file" error. (PR #155)
ci: Upgrade GitHub Actions to Node 24-compatible versions. (PR #145)
feat: Added network proxy configuration in Settings for Electron client and backend-connected browser modes, supporting HTTP and SOCKS5 protocols with optional authentication. (PR #163)
feat: Replaced top paginator on Releases page with "Show All / Unread Only" dropdown filter and "Mark All as Read" button with backend persistence. (PR #171)
feat: Added structured logging system with automatic sensitive data sanitization and "Log Export" UI in Settings for AI-powered debugging. (PR #172)
fix: AI API error responses now include full response body details for better diagnostics. (PR #158)
fix: Sanitize README and repo description content before inserting into AI prompts to prevent JSON parse errors. (PR #159)
fix: AI config "Test Connection" button no longer fails with CORS network error for openai-compatible endpoints. (PR #161)
fix: Upgraded frontend Dockerfile from Node 18 to Node 22 for Vite compatibility. (PR #162)
fix: Fixed "AI config not found" error when testing connection or analyzing repos in backend mode. (PR #167)
fix: Hardened AI/WebDAV config sync to prevent data loss from encryption failures and empty submissions. (PR #168)
fix: Tooltips now always show on hover for repository descriptions; added tooltips to Trending page. (PR #170)
fix: Optimized default AI prompt to reduce thinking process output and enforce JSON-only responses. (PR #175)

feat: Added Diagnostic Logs panel in Settings with in-app log viewer and debug capture mode, supporting frontend/backend debug toggles, event type filtering, real-time updates, HTTP request details, and log management (search, filter, clear, export). (PR #176)

fix: Diagnostic Logs — AI analysis now logs detailed request/response content across OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini providers; fixed debug log event type classification with operationTag mapping; level filter pills show checkmark when selected; debug indicator click navigates to logs tab. (PR #177)

fix: Fixed Release page empty-state icon not centered due to missing className space; items in unread-only mode no longer disappear immediately after marking as read via snapshot-based filtering. (PR #178)
fix: Fixed tooltips stuck on hover with pointermove listener and debounce; fixed dual-tooltip overlap on Trends page by splitting shared hide timer into independent timers. (PR #179)
feat: Added aria2 remote RPC download integration in Settings > Network, with configurable RPC host/port/secret, connection testing, SSRF protection, and download routing. (PR #186)
fix: Fixed proxy toggle in Network Settings reverting after page navigation — changes now sync immediately to Zustand store, backend, and Electron process. (PR #185)
fix: Fixed AI config sync returning 422 when ENCRYPTION_KEY is a short hex string — keys are now auto-normalized to 32 bytes via SHA-256 derivation. (PR #187)
fix: Fixed AI tags disappearing after backend sync — empty arrays no longer overwrite existing AI analysis data during repository updates. (PR #187)
fix: Fixed RPC download secret being lost after app restart by persisting it in Zustand IndexedDB storage. (PR #189)
feat: Published pre-built backend Docker images to GHCR and updated deployment documentation for registry-based installs. (PR #190)
fix: Added multi-architecture Docker builds for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, improving support for Apple Silicon and ARM servers. (PR #191)
fix: Added official DeepSeek and MiMo AI provider handling and prevented reasoning/thinking output from leaking into analysis results. (PR #193)
fix: Reduced repository-card AI analysis jank with narrower subscriptions, local loading state, idle persistence, and faster filtering. Thanks to external contributor @xinvxueyuan. (PR #199)
fix: Clearing the repository search input now resets stale search state before sorting or filtering. (PR #202)
fix: README preview now dismisses stale tooltips before opening modals. (PR #203)
docs: Added standardized GitHub issue templates for bug reports and feature requests. (PR #204)
feat: Added multilingual README detection and switching with backend proxy support and cached variant loading. (PR #205)
fix: Improved AI summary validation and retry handling so prompt-like summaries are no longer saved. Thanks to external contributor @Chenpeel. (PR #208)
feat: Added a secure backup/export toggle for including sensitive keys, with masked defaults and safer import behavior. (PR #209)
fix: Improved Markdown code block rendering, preserving layout and translated code tag attributes. (PR #210)
feat: Added personal and organization fork owner selection with owner-scoped refresh, counts, search, pagination, and empty states. (PR #211)
fix: Resolved AI category sync and README proxy errors, including clearer README proxy messages and restored code block line numbers. (PR #212)

feat: Added configurable release sources with a Release Sources modal to toggle sources (starred, watched, custom repos), view per-source counts, manage custom/watch repos with add/remove and pagination, and sync watched GitHub repos. Source settings are included in export/import backups and backend auto-sync. (PR #215)
fix: Added direct GitHub API fallback for README content when the backend proxy fails but a frontend GitHub token is available, covering both single and multilingual README scenarios. (PR #214)

fix: Resolved React hook and Fast Refresh lint warnings; cleaned Vite build warning noise by aligning bundle warning thresholds and Rolldown options; fixed TypeScript errors across store types, backup/import panels, diagnostic log rendering, and markdown code block typing. (PR #217)
feat: Added Gist management tab with full CRUD support, AI analysis, semantic search, and syntax-highlighted code viewer. Note: requires gist scope on your GitHub PAT. (PR #223)
feat: Added "Latest Version Only" filter on the Release Timeline page to show only the most recent release per repository. (PR #219)
fix: Data cleanup in Settings now correctly removes only orphaned read-release markers instead of clearing all read state. (PR #220)
fix: Gist proxy support — route Gist API requests through backend proxy, add raw content proxy for truncated files, render extensionless files as plaintext. (PR #224)
feat: Header menu customization — show/hide and reorder navigation items via drag-and-drop in Settings > Menu Management. (PR #226)
feat: Sync button relocated to Repositories page control bar with localized last-synced timestamp. (PR #226)
feat: Responsive navigation using pure CSS breakpoints, eliminating text wrapping on narrow viewports. (PR #226)

feat: Added Vector Semantic Search with Cloudflare Vectorize integration — search starred repositories using natural language with semantic understanding. This is an experimental feature; please evaluate carefully before upgrading.
feat: Added embedding support for 6 providers (OpenAI, OpenAI-compatible, SiliconFlow, Gemini, Cohere, Ollama) with configurable index modes (Description/README).
feat: Added auto-indexing for new repos after sync and incremental indexing support.
fix: Fixed vector search results being overwritten by filters and sort operations.
fix: Worker authentication security improvements and various audit fixes.
feat: Added true incremental vector indexing with vector_indexed_at tracking across the full data pipeline, unindexed repo count badge, and concurrent README fetching. (PR #230)
feat: Optimized vector search with true semantic reranking, HyDE query preprocessing, structured embedding text, keyword boosting, and configurable search parameters in Settings UI. (PR #231)
fix: Fixed JSON parsing greedy regex, variable shadowing in keyword boosting, HyDE timeout cleanup, stale closure issues, and ISO 8601 validation for vector_indexed_at. (PR #230, #231)
fix: Added EMBEDDING_FORMAT_VERSION tracking to auto-trigger full reindex when embedding text format changes. (PR #231)
fix: Stabilized real-time search during IME composition — results now pause during text composition (e.g., Chinese/Japanese input) and resume after completion.
fix: Resetting search to whitespace correctly restores the full repository list instead of showing stale results.
fix: Fixed incremental-index button triggering full reindex on every reload by preserving embeddingFormatVersion across store hydration.
fix: Centralized vector search config defaults and normalization for consistent persistence, preventing config drift.
fix: Added safe value clamping for vector search config thresholds to prevent corrupted values from reaching the worker.

feat: Published a pre-built, multi-architecture (amd64 + arm64) frontend Docker image to GHCR so users can run it directly or via docker-compose without building locally; the Nginx backend proxy is now configurable via BACKEND_HOST, and Docker/README docs plus .dockerignore were updated. (PR #240)

feat: Added a "Find similar repositories" action on repository cards powered by the vector search index — hovering a card reveals a Find similar button that replaces the list with the most similar repositories, supports chained lookups, and provides a reset banner; similar mode exits on new search or category filter. (PR #242)

feat: Added an AI "Summary" toggle button on Release cards that calls the configured AI service to generate an importance-ranked Markdown summary (new features / bug fixes) of the release notes in the UI language, with loading state, expand/collapse animation, inline error display, and retry. (PR #243)

fix: Raised the AI analysis and semantic reranking max token budget to 4096 so thinking-capable models finish their reasoning chain and emit valid JSON instead of truncating and returning empty content. (PR #241)

feat: Embedded optional read-only MCP server (Streamable HTTP + legacy SSE) so AI agents (Claude Code / Cursor) can search AI-enriched starred repos; supports frontend+backend, Docker (/mcp), and Electron loopback; Settings UI for enable/token/agent JSON. Experimental — back up data before upgrading; only available with backend or desktop client, not pure SPA. (PR #250)

fix: Allow user-owned AI / WebDAV / RPC proxy configs to use private/loopback IPs (e.g. local Ollama, LAN NAS) while still blocking cloud metadata and embedded credentials; fixed IPv4-mapped IPv6 bypass. (PR #246, fixes #244)

fix: WebDAV backup/restore now preserves release subscriptions (bell), release source settings (Watch / custom), and read-release markers (backup version 1.1; older 1.0 backups remain compatible). (PR #249)

feat: Added end-to-end repository license recognition — license metadata is now fetched, stored, and normalized across the whole pipeline (GitHub API → DB → AI/embedding/search → UI filter → MCP server). Repository cards display a license badge, and the filter panel supports filtering by license (including "No license"). License is also included in AI context, vector embeddings, and MCP search, which gained a licenses filter parameter, byLicense stats, and a projected license field. Note: repository metadata fields changed (EMBEDDING_FORMAT_VERSION bumped to 3), so please re-index your vector search index. (PR #254, closes #251)
feat: Repository-grouped release cards now show the latest release date (relative time) next to the newest tag, consistent with the card header. (PR #256, closes #255)

feat: Windows/Linux: the native menu bar is now hidden by default (press Alt to reveal temporarily) while keeping all keyboard shortcuts (copy/paste/DevTools). Restyled the window scrollbars with a slim translucent design and dark-mode hover states, and eliminated the horizontal scrollbar at the bottom of the window. (PR #257, closes #252)

feat: Category classification now uses the effective tags actually shown on repository cards (custom_tags > ai_tags > topics) instead of only ai_tags, aligning category matching with display and search. A new categoryMatchMode setting (default Effective; Legacy keeps the old ai_tags-only behavior) controls this, manual category assignments (including explicit clears) are preserved and no longer overwritten by AI analysis, and custom categories fall back to repository metadata keywords when a repo has no topics. (PR #264, closes #262)

fix: GitHub PAT / API_SECRET is now persisted to IndexedDB (persist v10) with a synchronous localStorage auth mirror fallback, so users are no longer re-prompted for the token after a Docker restart or tab close; logout performs a full credential teardown, and the new POST /api/sync/auth route (Cache-Control: no-store) enables cross-device session restore. (PR #260, closes #259)

fix: The full vector-search config (search_threshold, search_top_k, enable_hyde, enable_reranking, embedding_format_version) is now persisted to the backend instead of silently dropping fields (which could force an unwanted full re-index); a canonical fingerprint stops the endless push/pull sync loop, and a bootstrap guard prevents a fresh backend from wiping locally configured vector search on first sync. (PR #261)

feat: Added shared AI request rate limiting for batch analysis, with retry-aware cooldowns, exponential backoff, a circuit breaker, optional concurrency and requests-per-minute controls, and forwarded provider rate-limit signals. (PR #265)

fix: Refreshing existing repository releases now detects changed assets and metadata, merges updates safely, preserves read/unread status, and uses the newest non-prerelease release when prereleases are excluded. (PR #266, fixes #263)
feat: Added a persisted Grid/List switch for repositories. The new compact list layout keeps essential metadata and actions accessible, while the grid view remains the default. (PR #268, closes #267)

fix: Centralized application versioning around the root package.json, synchronized package-lock metadata automatically, removed the duplicate Electron version field, and strengthened release validation against duplicate or downgraded versions. (PR #270)

fix: Cloudflare Worker Vectorize upserts now compact oversized metadata using UTF-8 JSON byte limits while preserving structured fields, with safer handling for long descriptions, tags, malformed license metadata, and excessive similarity-search limits. Cloudflare Worker users must redeploy the Worker to receive this fix. (PR #271)

fix: Refreshing releases now marks entries as unread when assets or metadata change, uses the newest asset update as the effective display time, and shows an Assets updated indicator without changing unaffected releases. (PR #272)

feat: Added experimental two-way synchronization with GitHub native Lists, including optional sync modes, list-to-tag/category mapping, protected categories, and push-back from local categories. Back up data before trying this feature; existing users and users who do not use GitHub native Lists should continue using the legacy synchronization mode. (PR #273)

fix: The Assets updated indicator now follows the release read state and disappears after the release is marked as read, with consistent behavior in release cards and repository group headers. (PR #274)

feat: Repository READMEs (Repos and Trending) and release notes now render with official GitHub styling via vendored github-markdown-css dual themes, adding support for GitHub Alerts (> [!NOTE] callouts), gemoji short codes, KaTeX math formulas, and Mermaid diagrams; KaTeX and Mermaid are lazily loaded so startup speed and bundle budget stay unaffected, while the table of contents, side-by-side translation, and copy-code buttons remain fully compatible. (PR #287)

refactor: Migrated the presentation layer to shadcn/ui style components built on Radix Primitives. The previous CSS and components were hand-rolled; this migration unifies the UI specification across the app and lays the foundation for consistent, faster iteration going forward. The global theme now uses standard semantic variables (background, foreground, card, popover, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, input, ring, radius), shared controls such as Button, Badge, Input, Card, Select, Checkbox, Switch, Tabs, Dialog, and AlertDialog follow the canonical defaults, and dark-theme foreground colors on primary actions were fixed. Business logic and data flow are unchanged — no data migration is required — and an unused react-router-dom dependency was removed so production npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities. (PR #284)

fix: Release update times now aggregate asset updates across all visible releases, newly added and changed assets are tracked accurately during refresh, and asset-level Assets updated markers appear consistently in both release views with effective update times in repository headers. (PR #280)

fix: Per-asset Assets updated badges are decoupled from release read state — expanding a release or marking it read no longer hides its asset badges; each badge can be dismissed independently via a new per-asset read action, and mark-all-as-read also clears every badge. (PR #283)
fix: Right-aligned the latest-release timestamp in the repository header for visual consistency with the release count and latest tag rows. (PR #275)

fix: Removed the duplicate preset-filter Reset button and the redundant selected-filter summary row from the expanded Release filter panel, keeping a single top-level Clear all filters action. (PR #281)

fix: An existing frontend GitHub token is now synced idempotently to the Docker backend after local state hydration, fixing GITHUB_TOKEN_NOT_CONFIGURED errors for existing sessions without requiring users to log in again. (PR #277, closes #276)

fix: GitHub Lists GraphQL queries automatically fall back to a direct browser connection when the backend proxy fails (network errors, 5xx, or missing backend token), transient server errors are retried instead of treated as permanent, backend error details are surfaced for diagnosis, and proxy usage is preserved whenever it works. (PR #278)

fix: Watched-repository synchronization no longer fails when GitHub returns an empty 204 No Content response for the public subscriptions endpoint, redundant public-endpoint requests were removed from the sync path, empty Watch lists sync cleanly, and license metadata is normalized to SPDX identifiers. (PR #286, closes #285)

feat: Added multi-theme one-click switching with 12 built-in presets (each with matched light + dark palettes), selectable in Settings > General > Appearance with live previews, and fully tokenized all hardcoded styles (colors, radii, shadows, fonts) onto semantic design tokens so every preset restyles correctly; existing users keep exactly the same default look after upgrade. (PR #289, #290)
ci: Lint, typecheck, and tests now run as required quality gates on every pull request and push to main. (PR #291)

test: Froze persistence and repository behavior contracts with historical-snapshot fixtures, fixing hydration gaps exposed by the new contracts: backend API secret priority handling, explicit-clear semantics, analyzing-state reset, and stale discovery cache cleanup. (PR #292)

perf: Lazy-loaded dormant views (Settings, Discovery/Subscription, Gists, Releases, Forks, README modal) with a deterministic bundle report, shrinking the modern entry from 2,398 KiB to 323 KiB and the largest legacy chunk from 2,762 KiB to 996 KiB. (PR #293)
fix: Closing the README modal now restores keyboard focus to the repository card that opened it instead of dropping focus to the page body. (PR #294)

refactor: Major architecture refactor of the frontend - repository state transitions centralized as pure commands (PR #295); RepositoryCard operations moved into a domain hook (PR #296); RepositoryList batch AI and bulk workflows moved into job hooks (PR #297); settings-page orchestration moved into focused action hooks (PR #298); the app store modularized behind a single persistence shell with unchanged schema (key github-stars-manager, version 11) (PR #299); untyped store subscriptions replaced with typed shallow selectors app-wide (PR #300); frontend layering boundaries enforced via ESLint with the contract published as ADR 0001 (PR #301). No data migration required.

feat: Added a repository-level View releases action with a theme-aware release sheet, paginated assets and notes, source ZIP/TAR archives, optional AI summaries, and browser or aria2 RPC downloads. (PR #302)

feat: Added an early-stage Repository Q&A Assistant with commit-pinned, read-only GitHub evidence, local per-repository conversation history, traceable source cards, and configurable retrieval budgets. It is designed for simple questions and does not index every repository file. (PR #303, #306)

feat: The Repository Q&A Assistant now uses an evidence-driven workflow with progressive evidence retrieval, explicit evidence gates, citation validation, clearer timelines, and more reliable similar-repository relevance. (PR #306)

fix: Stabilized the repository edit modal by preserving drafts during background sync, preventing overlay click-through, and adding fixed header/footer regions with a dedicated scrolling content area. (PR #305)

ci: Stabilized multi-architecture Docker publishing: the frontend static build now runs once on its native platform instead of under slow QEMU emulation, superseded publishing runs are canceled automatically, and the frontend/backend images use separate build caches with timeouts, making amd64 + arm64 publishing reliable. (PR #307)

feat: Added an optional all-in-one Docker image (ghcr.io/amintacccp/github-stars-manager) that serves the web UI and the backend API from a single container, with a docker-compose.fullstack.yml example and setup/migration docs; all existing deployment options remain unchanged. (PR #308)

fix: The repository edit modal no longer closes by itself seconds after opening it from a keyword-searched list (background sync no longer wipes active search results), and the page no longer jitters when the scrollbar appears or hides thanks to a constant scrollbar gutter. (PR #310)

feat: Major Repository Q&A experience upgrade: real streaming answers rendered character by character (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Claude, Gemini and compatible providers), a task depth selector (Default / Quick / Deep / Unlimited) that controls retrieval rounds and read scope, inline file:line citation badges with hover previews that jump to the exact GitHub source line, a collapsible execution timeline, and copy/regenerate actions under each answer; also fixed the top header disappearing when dropdowns opened. (PR #311)

fix: The AI search bar no longer covers the top header when scrolled, and the page behind an open modal or side sheet is now properly scroll-locked, fixing the double scrollbars in the Repository Q&A sheet. (PR #312)

feat: Unified platform icons to Simple Icons brand glyphs, added square platform badges and per-asset update dates to release asset rows, and made platform detection deterministic from file extensions and filename semantics across recent releases, so repository cards show what a project actually builds. (PR #313)

feat: The Repository Q&A Assistant gains Release notes and asset list sources (answering "what changed recently" and "which platform builds are provided") and GitHub issue search including closed issues with comment excerpts (answering "I hit this problem, how do I fix it"); an experimental native function calling tool loop is also available and disabled by default. The assistant remains an early-stage feature intended for simple questions, not whole-codebase analysis. (PR #314)

feat: Rebuilt the no-vector AI search fallback as a three-stage lexical recall + LLM selection chain (query expansion with intent restatement, local weighted lexical recall of ~100 candidates, then LLM selection of genuinely relevant repositories), with fault-tolerant result parsing (real repository IDs first, row-number fallback), preserved AI relevance ordering, honest empty results, and a lexical top-100 fallback; measured P@5 improved from 0.21 to 0.67 on a real 951-repo library. (PR #331)

feat: Added MCP discovery tools: bounded read-only gsm_get_repos batch lookup, deterministic local gsm_get_repo_evidence (local database and release cache only, no GitHub fan-out), gsm_find_similar_repos via the vector query path, and metadata filters on gsm_vector_search; backend and Electron tool contracts stay aligned (10 tools with vector search enabled, 8 without). (PR #330)

fix: MCP gsm_status now reports the real application version from synchronized package metadata instead of a hard-coded 0.7.0, lists available and conditional tools, and gsm_get_repo_evidence exposes evidence freshness metadata; the release version script now synchronizes server package metadata with journal/backup rollback and interrupted-run recovery. (PR #333)

feat: Added an "Already have backend data" login path that restores the GitHub token and synchronized data from an existing backend using a backend URL and API Key, with guided token setup, remembered and normalized backend URLs, HTTPS-only remote address enforcement, and distinct backend vs GitHub token error handling. (PR #327)

feat: Added a Network Request Routing option (auto / backend / browser) under Settings > Backend, letting GitHub data-plane requests egress from the current device when the self-hosted backend cannot reach GitHub; aria2 download routing is unchanged and the setting stays local per device. (PR #323)

fix: GitHub Lists now follow the app language: new lists are created with translated category names, and matched existing lists are auto-renamed best-effort on language switch without blocking sync. (PR #332)

fix: RPC (aria2) downloads can be retried after a successful send with per-asset-version success checkmarks, empty release changelogs are backfilled on refresh via body/name/tag change detection, and release card time and action columns stay aligned. (PR #324)
fix: The "Assets updated" badge no longer squeezes the timestamp into wrapping; the metadata column expands leftward and timestamps stay on one line. (PR #329)

fix: Accessibility and visual polish: prefers-reduced-motion support, placeholder contrast raised to 4.76:1 light / 8.2:1 dark, Chinese relative dates in the Chinese UI, copyable card text, keyboard navigation for search suggestions, a Clear all filters empty-state exit, unified dialog elevation, a 12px minimum badge size, and localized confirm-dialog buttons. (PR #334)

fix: Upgraded dependencies to clear all 31 external security scan findings (axios 1.20.0 fixing 10 CVEs, morgan 1.12.0, express 4.22.2, plus qs/fast-uri/ip-address/hono/form-data/decode-uri-component overrides); self-hosted users should redeploy updated images. (PR #328)

refactor: Completed the frontend layering migration (ADR 0001): the last 10 components were moved into action hooks and the component allowlist mechanism was deleted, with no behavior changes. (PR #326)
refactor: Banned update/translate services in view components and migrated six components into five new action hooks. (PR #325)

ci: Upgraded all Docker publishing workflows to Node 24-based official Docker actions, eliminating Node 20 deprecation warnings, and unified release asset platform badges between the Release page and the repository release sheet. (PR #315)
ci: Fixed the frontend Docker build failure caused by the prebuild version-sync hook running inside a build context that excludes the server directory. (PR #335)
